The snake has a glossy, smooth body with a distinct two-tone coloration: a dark reddish-brown dorsal side and a pale pinkish-white ventral side. The head is small, rounded, and barely distinct from the neck, featuring a blunt snout and a visible, shiny black eye. The scales appear smooth and reflective.
